{{inh+|pt|roa-opt|mão||hand}}, from {{inh|pt|la|manus|5=hand}}, from {{inh|pt|itc-pro|*manus}}, perhaps from {{der|pt|ine-pro|*méh₂r̥|*méh₂-r̥ ~ *mh₂-én-}}, derived from {{der|pt|ine-pro|*(s)meh₂-||to beckon}}, or perhaps from a {{der|pt|ine-pro||*mon-u-}} (see the Proto-Italic entry).
